title: AI chat therapist subscription (stripped)
idea: A consumer subscription app at $19/month offering round-the-clock automated conversational support for anxiety and mild depression, in a style modelled on talk-based mental health treatment. Small footer text states that the service is always-available support and not a replacement for licensed care. The backend sends every message to a single external language-model vendor behind a long system prompt, with retrieval over a library of structured self-help worksheets. A fixed helpline message is returned whenever certain crisis keywords appear. No licensed clinician is in the loop. It launches simultaneously in one high-income and one middle-income market.
focus_notes: Quality ceiling / harmful advice / hallucination in clinical-adjacent domain
Trust collapse after one viral failure story
